From 5427290d64c752b97d6a2af7506771c7d10eb750 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kinglong Mee <kinglongmee@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2017 17:22:43 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] SUNRPC/backchanel: set XPT_CONG_CTRL flag for bc xprt

The xprt for backchannel is created separately, not in TCP/UDP code.  It
needs the XPT_CONG_CTRL flag set on it too--otherwise requests on the
NFSv4.1 backchannel are rjected in svc_process_common():

1191         if (versp->vs_need_cong_ctrl &&
1192             !test_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &rqstp->rq_xprt->xpt_flags))
1193                 goto err_bad_vers;

Fixes: 5283b03ee5 ("nfs/nfsd/sunrpc: enforce transport...")
Signed-off-by: Kinglong Mee <kinglongmee@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Jeff Layton <jlayton@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: J. Bruce Fields <bfields@redhat.com>

diff --git a/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c b/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c
index 8931e33b6541..2b720fa35c4f 100644
--- a/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c
+++ b/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c
@@ -1635,6 +1635,7 @@ static struct svc_xprt *svc_bc_create_socket(struct svc_serv *serv,
 
 	xprt = &svsk->sk_xprt;
 	svc_xprt_init(net, &svc_tcp_bc_class, xprt, serv);
+	set_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &svsk->sk_xprt.xpt_flags);
 
 	serv->sv_bc_xprt = xprt;
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/sunrpc/svcsock.c`**
   - A new line was added to set the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag for the backchannel transport (`xprt`). Specifically, the line `set_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &svsk->sk_xprt.xpt_flags);` was inserted after the initialization of the transport in the `svc_bc_create_socket` function.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a bug where requests on the NFSv4.1 backchannel were being rejected due to the absence of the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag. By setting this flag in the backchannel transport, the patch ensures that the transport adheres to the congestion control requirements, thus preventing the rejection of requests in the `svc_process_common()` function. This change is directly related to the fix for the issue identified in the commit referenced (5283b03ee5).

Here is the commit message:
SUNRPC/backchanel: set XPT_CONG_CTRL flag for bc xprt

The xprt for backchannel is created separately, not in TCP/UDP code.  It
needs the XPT_CONG_CTRL flag set on it too--otherwise requests on the
NFSv4.1 backchannel are rjected in svc_process_common():

1191         if (versp->vs_need_cong_ctrl &&
1192             !test_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &rqstp->rq_xprt->xpt_flags))
1193                 goto err_bad_vers;

Fixes: 5283b03ee5 ("nfs/nfsd/sunrpc: enforce transport...")
Signed-off-by: Kinglong Mee <kinglongmee@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Jeff Layton <jlayton@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: J. Bruce Fields <bfields@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug occurs because the backchannel transport (`xprt`) for NFSv4.1 does not have the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag set, which is necessary for proper congestion control. As a result, when the system checks for this flag in the `svc_process_common()` function, it finds that the flag is not set, leading to the rejection of requests. This indicates that the backchannel transport was not configured correctly to handle congestion control, which is essential for maintaining the stability and performance of the NFSv4.1 protocol.

Here is the patch:
  */
 static struct svc_xprt *svc_bc_create_socket(struct svc_serv *serv,
 					     int protocol,
 					     struct net *net,
 					     struct sockaddr *sin, int len,
 					     int flags)
 {
 	struct svc_sock *svsk;
 	struct svc_xprt *xprt;
 
 	if (protocol != IPPROTO_TCP) {
 		printk(KERN_WARNING "svc: only TCP sockets"
 			" supported on shared back channel\n");
 		return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);
 	}
 
 	svsk = kzalloc(sizeof(*svsk), GFP_KERNEL);
 	if (!svsk)
 		return ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);
 
 	xprt = &svsk->sk_xprt;
 	svc_xprt_init(net, &svc_tcp_bc_class, xprt, serv);
+	set_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &svsk->sk_xprt.xpt_flags);
 
 	serv->sv_bc_xprt = xprt;
 
 	return xprt;
 }

The bug occurs because the condition checks if the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag is set on the backchannel transport (`xprt`). If this flag is not set, requests are rejected, indicating that the backchannel transport is not properly configured for congestion control.

The code statements that fix the bug are:

Reason:
This statement sets the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag on the backchannel transport (`xprt`), ensuring that it is configured correctly for congestion control. This allows the system to process requests without rejecting them due to the absence of the required flag.
